security_audit.summary: I confirmed the API endpoint and cURL network findings because the skill sends prompts to verging.ai, an external service. The API-key detections are placeholders or environment-variable references, not embedded credentials. The Ruby and shell backtick findings are markdown code fences and inline code, not executable logic or prompt injection.

remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy note that messages, system prompts, and request metadata are sent to verging.ai. Advise users not to submit secrets or regulated data.
Keep credential examples as placeholders and environment variables. Recommend rotating keys if a key is copied into chat, logs, or command history.
Label cURL blocks as user examples. State that agents should ask before making network requests for the user.

content.value_statement: Teams need a quick way to call GPT-4o through the verging.ai API. This skill documents authenticated requests, streaming responses, and token usage.
actual_capabilities: Documents authenticated verging.ai chat requests using an API key header.
Shows non-streaming chat completion requests for the chat endpoint.
Shows streaming Server-Sent Events requests with the stream option.
Lists supported message roles, temperature, and max token parameters.
Describes token usage, credit consumption, and common error responses.
limitations: Requires an active verging.ai API key and enough account credits.
Sends prompts and request data to the external verging.ai service.
Does not provide an SDK, package, or local model runtime.
Model availability and billing depend on the verging.ai service.

use_cases.title: Prototype Chat API Calls
use_cases.description: Create a first verging.ai chat request with required headers, messages, and generation settings.

use_cases.title: Add Streaming UX
use_cases.description: Understand how to request Server-Sent Events and process streamed response chunks.

use_cases.title: Estimate Usage and Errors
use_cases.description: Review credit rules, token usage, and common API error responses before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Chat Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single completion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to prepare a non-streaming verging.ai chat request for: [task]. Include authentication and required message fields.

prompt_templates.title: Enable Streaming Responses
prompt_templates.scenario: Add streamed output to an application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to request a streaming GPT-4o response with verging.ai. Explain how chunks and the final event are handled.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Generation Settings
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose parameters for a specific workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a verging.ai chat request for [use case] with temperature and max token recommendations. Explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Integration Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan production use with operational controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a production integration that uses verging.ai chat completions. Include auth, rate limits, credits, retries, and sensitive data controls.

output_examples.input: Ask for a non-streaming chat completion that explains a technical topic.
output_examples.output: A concise request plan with the endpoint, authorization requirement, message structure, and generation parameters.

output_examples.input: Ask how to stream a response for a chat interface.
output_examples.output: A streaming plan that explains Server-Sent Events, content chunks, usage reporting, and completion handling.

output_examples.input: Ask how to prepare for credit and rate limit failures.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting guide that maps credit, rate limit, and upstream errors to practical next actions.

best_practices: Store the verging.ai API key in an environment variable or secret manager.
Review prompts for sensitive data before sending them to the external API.
Set temperature and max token values intentionally for each workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into prompts, source files, or shared transcripts.
Do not send regulated or private data without approval for third-party processing.
Do not assume streaming responses include final usage data until the final event arrives.

faq.question: Does this skill run a local model?
faq.answer: No. It documents calls to the verging.ai API, which proxies GPT-4o.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: You need a verging.ai API key and enough account credits for the request.

faq.question: Can it stream responses?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents Server-Sent Events streaming with a stream option.

faq.question: What data leaves my environment?
faq.answer: The messages and request parameters you send are transmitted to verging.ai.

faq.question: Does it include an SDK?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides API request guidance and examples, not a client library.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
